target_pattern: Express ownership naturally with de quien + es/son, use possessive adjectives before nouns (mi, tu, su), and switch to article + possessive pronouns when replacing nouns (el mio, la tuya, los suyos), clarifying su/suyo with de + person when needed.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Thinking in direct English ownership order and translating whose literally.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish asks ownership with de quien + es/son and uses different forms for before nouns versus replacing nouns.
target_pattern_formula: No, no es mio/mia. Es de + name.
No, no son mios/mias. Son de + name.
Use de el/de ella/de ellos to clarify su/suyo when ambiguous.
natural_examples: No, no es mio. Es de Laura.
No, no son mias. Son de mi jefe.

controlled_recombination.instructions: Write each in Spanish using the ownership patterns. No answer key until the end.
prompts_en: No, it is not mine. It is Daniel's.
No, they are not mine. They are Sofia's.
No, it is not mine. It is my sister's.
No, they are not mine. They are the director's.
No, they are not his. They are ours.
No, it is not mine. It is theirs.

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: De quien es el portatil? -> change noun to plural (los portatiles).
Base: De quien son las llaves? -> change noun to singular (la llave).
Base: No, no es mio. -> change speaker to feminine.
Base: No, no son mias. -> change possessor to masculine plural.
Base: Es de Carlos. -> replace with possessive pronoun (suyo).
Base: Son de Ana. -> replace with possessive pronoun (suyas).
Base: Es tuyo? -> make it plural feminine.
Base: Son tuyas? -> make it singular masculine.
Base: Es su computadora. -> clarify owner is her using de.
Base: Son sus documentos. -> clarify owner is them using de.
Base: Es mi abrigo. -> replace noun with possessive pronoun.
Base: Son tus gafas. -> replace noun with possessive pronoun.
Base: De quien es la silla? -> ask about los asientos.
Base: No, no es suyo. -> change to first person plural ownership.
Base: Son nuestras llaves. -> rewrite with pronoun-only answer.

prompts: Whose laptop is it? (De quien es el portatil? vs Quien de es el portatil?)
Whose reports are they? (De quien son los informes? vs De quien es los informes?)
It's mine. (Es mio. vs Es mi.)
They are mine. (Son mios. vs Son mi.)
Is it yours? (Es tuyo? vs Es tu?)
Are they yours? (Son tuyas? vs Son tuyasas?)
It's her office. (Es su oficina. vs Es la oficina su.)
It's hers. (Es suya. vs Es ella.)
They are theirs. (Son suyos. vs Son de su.)
It's his car. (Es su coche. vs Es coche suyo as neutral default sentence)

guided_personal_writing.instructions: Write one Spanish sentence for each specific meaning.
prompts: Write that you are asking whose charger this is at work.
Write that your coworker asks if the notebook is yours.
Write that the keys are not yours; they are your manager's.
Write that those documents are yours.
Write that the blue backpack is your partner's.
Write that you ask whose headphones those are.
Write that your phone is on the desk and your colleague's is in the bag.
Write that your team's office is on the second floor.
Write that the client's files are not yours.
Write that you clarify su computadora means her computer.
Write that those chairs are theirs, not yours.
Write that your glasses are in the car.
Write that the report is yours and the presentation is your coworker's.
Write that you ask if the parked car is his.
Write that those tickets are ours.

prompts_en: His is on the table, mine is in my bag.
I think that office is hers.
Are these your keys or his?
That jacket isn't yours, it's mine.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Literal transfer from English who is.

common_errors.mistake: Es mi when noun is omitted

common_errors.why_it_happens: Not switching to plural pronoun form.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Es su casa or Es la casa de ella.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Using adjective form instead of pronoun form.
Combining pronoun phrase with a noun incorrectly.
common_errors.correct_spanish: mi coche or el mio (without noun).

common_errors.mistake: Overusing possessives with body parts/clothing in obvious context
common_errors.correct_spanish: Often article preferred: Me duele la cabeza. Ponte la camisa.
Clarify with de el/de ella/de ellos when needed.

common_errors.mistake: Gender mismatch like la mio or los mia
common_errors.why_it_happens: Tracking owner instead of noun gender/number.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Match replaced noun: la mia, los mios, las suyas.
